newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-MIM says Mt Isa rail link shut until Monday.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-MIM says Mt Isa rail link shut until Monday.

text.p: Base metals giant MIM Holdings Ltd said the rail link used for transporting its products between Mt Isa and Townsville has been cut by flood waters and is expected to be closed until Monday next week.
"The traffic of metals from Mt Isa to Townsville has stopped," MIM general manager, public affairs, Collin Myers told Reuters.
"It is not known when the road will be opened. The rail is expected to be closed until Monday," he said.
Myers said the effect of the flooding in large parts of central Queensland on MIM production has been "minimal."
The Queensland state government earlier declared much of central Queensland a disaster area after flooding as a result of cyclonic rains over the past few days.
"The flooding comes at a time of relatively low copper production when the Mt Isa smelter has been shut down for maintenance work," Myers said.
"Operations at Mt Isa are continuing," he said.
Meanwhile MIM was stockpiling production of anode copper, lead bullion and zinc concentrate, normally transported by rail.
